latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video Enhancer for easy cloud-based video upscaling and sharpening.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; no local software needed.
- Simple, chat-based interface: just describe video enhancement needs and receive upscaled MP4s in minutes.
- Handles authentication and session management automatically, including free anonymous starter credits.
- Cloud GPU processing with real-time status updates and clear error handling.
- Designed for creators and social media users looking to improve video quality fast.
